title: MakeItBeauty kit component (v0)
description: A declarative, parameterized design fragment, referenced from designs as "kit/{id}". Nodes are design-schema nodes positioned relative to the frame; {{props.*}} slots resolve with the standard template engine; computed entries map a numeric prop linearly onto node geometry (prop × scale, clamped) — no code execution. Nested instance nodes are not allowed (v0). Two variants (see if/else): declarative (nodes required — they ARE the component; native/dataFields absent) and native (native: true + dataFields — a TRUSTED generator inside the renderer produces the render nodes from (props, data, frame); array-driven visuals like a 53×7 contribution heatmap cannot be expressed declaratively; declared nodes are only the static palette preview, so [] or absent is fine). Native components ship with MakeItBeauty itself: community publish validation rejects native/dataFields. This file is the contract for packages/kit/components.

id.description: Component id; instances reference it as "kit/{id}".

category.description: Optional palette-menu category, a lowercase slug. The editor groups components under it and treats uncategorized components as a catch-all bucket. Recommended taxonomy (official kit uses exactly these): cards (framed containers/showcases), stats (single-number metrics and meters), data (array-driven connector visuals), banners (wide text/header strips), decor (dividers and ornaments).

frame.description: The component's own coordinate space. Expansion uniform-scales it into the instance box by s = min(instance.w/frame.w, instance.h/frame.h), top-left aligned.

props.description: Declared slots. Instance props merge over these defaults; {{props.name}} placeholders in nodes resolve to the merged values.

nodes.description: Design-schema fragment, positioned relative to the frame — (0,0) is the component's own top-left corner. Required (min 1) for declarative components; for native components it is only the static palette preview and may be [] or absent (see if/else).

native.description: Official-kit only: the renderer produces this component's nodes with a trusted generator from (props, data, frame) — array-driven visuals (heatmap cells, language bars) that declarative fragments cannot express. The declared nodes remain as the static fallback/palette preview. Community publish validation rejects this flag; declaring it requires dataFields.

dataFields.description: Connector snapshot paths (e.g. "stats.calendar") a native component consumes directly — no {{templates}} involved. Binding derivation unions these into the design's connector binding (v0: the github connector) for every instance of the component, so the consent record stays complete.

then.description: Native component: the renderer's trusted generator supplies the render nodes, so declared nodes are only the static palette preview — [] or absent is fine.

else.description: Declarative component: the nodes ARE the component — required, at least one.

propDecl.description: A prop slot: type, optional description, and the default used when an instance omits the prop (and for the palette preview). The default must match the declared type. Color props are strings.

fragmentNode.description: Exactly the design-schema node types minus instance — nested instances are rejected in v0.

computedEntry.description: Linear map from a numeric prop onto a node's geometry: node[field] = clamp(props[prop] × scale, clamp[0], clamp[1]), in frame coordinates (instance scaling applies afterwards). Deliberately not an expression language.

node.description: id of a node in this component's nodes

prop.description: name of a declared prop of type number

clamp.description: [min, max] applied after scaling the prop.
